info.title: Stermont product photo upload
info.description: Attach photos to an existing product. Send the passcode as the API key (Bearer). The product must already exist (draft is fine).

post.summary: Attach one or more photos to a product
post.description: Pass attached chat images in openaiFileIdRefs, or direct https links / base64 in images. First photo becomes the main photo unless append is true; extra photos go to the gallery. Set activate to true only when the owner approves publishing.

product_id.description: Existing product id, lowercase-hyphen, e.g. kids-wooden-xylophone

images.description: Direct https image links, data: URLs, or base64 strings

image_url.description: Single direct https link to a jpg/png/webp/gif

image_base64.description: Single photo as base64 or a data: URL

append.description: Add to the gallery instead of replacing the main photo

activate.description: Publish the product once the photo is saved

207.description: Some photos saved, some failed; see results
